about: Hand labels for app.parts.oem_names.to_part: OEM row names from the microfiches cache (parts-honda.uk, bmw-spare-parts.com) with the diagram they sit in. label None = no canonical part (fastener, label, trim piece, anything doubtful). split: 'held' rows were set aside by a seeded shuffle and not looked at while tuning the mapper. kind: part | none | trap | fastener.
